methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
This source scopes the UN Digital Library (Invenio) to Economic and Social Council documents — every symbol beginning `E/`: resolutions (`E/RES/...`), session documents (`E/2023/...`) and functional-commission documents (`E/CN.x/...`). It reuses the shared UNDL Invenio mechanism, constrained to the ECOSOC series.

## Search
Endpoint `https://digitallibrary.un.org/search`, query in `p`, `of=recjson`. Constrain to ECOSOC with `191__b:"E/"` (default) or an exact symbol `191__a:"E/RES/2023/1"`. Combine with `year:`, subjects (`650__a`) or body (`710__a`) via Boolean `AND`.

## Filters
Symbol scope is the ECOSOC prefix (pre-set). Interface language `ln`; sort via `sf`/`so`.

## Pagination
Offset-1: `jrec` (1-based first-record index), `rg` (page size); page N = `jrec=(N-1)*rg+1`.

## Download
PDFs at `/record/{recid}/files/{filename}`, preferring `-EN.pdf`.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Per-record MARC21 XML at `/record/{recid}/export/xm?` (WAF-safe): symbol 191, title 245, subjects 650, ECOSOC body 981/710, files 856.

## Limitations
Scope is ECOSOC symbols only. The `/search` list endpoint is AWS-WAF-challenged for server-to-server calls (HTTP 202); the `export/xm` and `files` record paths are not, so enrichment and download are reliable while result-listing may need retries / a challenge solver.
probeNotes: Derived from the verified ods-ga probe (same Invenio platform). ECOSOC discriminator 191__b='E/' mirrors the GA 'A/' and SC 'S/' series subfields; download/enrich record paths confirmed WAF-safe on sibling ODS sources.
